svg.title: Room design at a glance
svg.desc: A quick reference for the renovation-pack, FreeCAD and Blender skills, including the occupied walkthrough and correction paths.
svg.text: From the brief to a checked plan, furnished camera and issued room
Begin a private revision, check the actual work and save it. Publication follows verified backup.
Open CHECKLIST.md with the history and reviews. Check outstanding surveys and design holds.

g.title: checklist
g.text: Create at intake. Refresh after each room review.
Track evidence, acceptance and survey returns.

g.title: shell
g.text: Build the shell, levels and door heads.
Set working sizes for unmeasured features.

g.title: decor
g.text: Check each surface, finish and approval.

g.title: survey
g.text: Name the owner and affected work.
Link the measured return and repeated check.

g.title: options
g.text: activities and journeys with the baseline.

g.title: study
g.text: Try poses on the checked shell.

g.title: decide
g.text: Show the labelled plan with the question.
Record the choice or deciding measurement.

g.title: style
g.text: Optional colour advice or AI styling study.

g.title: finish
g.text: Dress the whole room · Blender MCP

g.title: walkthrough
g.text: Can people enter, sit, rise and leave

g.title: camera
g.text: Inspect door heads, framing and reverse view.

g.title: ai
g.text: Compare the photo with the reviewed camera.
Check door operation and access to each seat.

g.title: release
g.text: Check door heads in the issued photo and room pack.
Update the checklist and deliver the issue.

g.title: ai->release
g.text: briefed views, operation and colours pass

g.title: assembled
g.text: Check visible rooms and window coverings
from inside and outside against current designs.
